clue.text: Brick left in ship at island

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the abbreviation for ship

parts.note: SS is the usual abbreviation for steamship
port is the left-hand side of a ship
the Isle of Man, an island in the Irish Sea, gives MAN

explanation.surface: A clay brick has been left aboard a ship that is moored at an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brick' is old-fashioned British slang for a good, dependable fellow, and so for a good sport.
explanation.definitionFit: A brick in dated slang is a sound, generous person, the kind of fair player called a good sport.

clue.text: Flow and go away, say?

indicators.note: say tells us we want a word that is pronounced like the slang term

parts.note: scarper is British slang for run off or go away

explanation.surface: A question about whether flowing water is the same as running away.
explanation.walkthrough: SCAPA Flow is the Orkney anchorage of the Royal Navy, so the answer is the word that goes with 'Flow'. In a non-rhotic British accent 'scarper' sounds like it.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition works as a fill-in: Scapa Flow is the famous natural harbour in Orkney, Scotland.

clue.text: Chapels provide alternative to a party

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
the Tories are the British Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Chapels offer a different option from a political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Oratories are small private chapels or places set apart for prayer.

clue.text: Monk becomes student on entering the notes

indicators.note: entering shows the student-and-on pair going inside the other pieces

parts.note: taken as written
IOUs are written promissory notes acknowledging a debt
L is the learner plate, a student driver
taken as written

explanation.surface: A monk turns into a student once he joins the musical notes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Monk' looks like a religious figure, but it is the jazz pianist Thelonious Monk; the answer is his first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Thelonious was the given name of jazz pianist Monk, so the surname points to the first name.

clue.text: Play with commander in American study

indicators.note: in places the commander inside the American subject

parts.note: math is the American word for the subject Britons call maths
CBE is Commander of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: A drama featuring an officer in the study of an American house.
explanation.definitionFit: Macbeth is Shakespeare's tragedy, a play about the Scottish king.

clue.text: See 9
German woman finds Germany a deceiver

parts.note: Frau is German for woman or Mrs
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: A German woman discovers her own country is a cheat.
explanation.definitionFit: A fraud can be a person, an impostor or cheat who deceives others.

clue.text: See 9
Boss doesn't open flower…

indicators.note: the word for boss loses its opening letter

parts.note: a master is the person in charge

explanation.surface: The boss refuses to open a flower shop.
explanation.definitionFit: An aster is a daisy-like garden plant with star-shaped blooms.

clue.text: …which follows many during homework in Athenian court

indicators.note: during puts one piece in the time span of the other, inside it

parts.note: DIY, do-it-yourself, is work done on one's own home

indicators.note: follows puts the flower after the Roman numeral

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a large number
which refers back through the ellipsis to the flower of the previous clue

explanation.surface: A court in ancient Athens arrives in the middle of household chores.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins the clue to 7-down: 'which' stands for that answer, the flower.
explanation.definitionFit: A dicastery was a court of jurors in ancient Athens; the word now also names a Vatican department.

clue.text: Qualifier for conversion by pet converter of laity on chapter

parts.note: a cat is a household pet

indicators.note: converter of says the letters of laity are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A pet converts the laity to the faith in a book chapter.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'catalytic' converter is the device in a car exhaust, so the adjective qualifies the word conversion's cousin.
explanation.definitionFit: Catalytic is the word that qualifies a converter in a car exhaust, describing the conversion process.

clue.text: Reach 99 after a game of Sorry?

indicators.note: after puts the reaching and the number behind the article and the sport

parts.note: polo is a game played on horseback
to reach a place is to get there
IC is 99 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Reaching 99 years old after a game of the board game Sorry.
explanation.walkthrough: Sorry! is a board game, which makes 'game of Sorry' look like one phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying sorry is being apologetic, expressing regret for something done.

clue.text: Colourful film …

parts.note: the coloured membrane of the eye, a thin layer read as a film

explanation.surface: A film shot in vivid colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Film' looks like a movie, but it is a thin layer; the coloured ring of the eye. Iris is also the Greek goddess of the rainbow.
explanation.definitionFit: The iris is the coloured ring-shaped membrane of the eye around the pupil.

clue.text: Short-lived fly, disturbed, can sleep outside

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: outside puts the word for sleep around the jumbled insect

parts.note: doss is British slang for sleep rough

indicators.note: disturbed says the letters of fly are jumbled

explanation.surface: An insect, briefly alive, is disturbed and can sleep outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short-lived' is an adjective here, and candyfloss works as one: in British use it describes anything sweet but insubstantial that soon vanishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Candyfloss, spun sugar, melts away almost at once, so it is used for anything fleeting.

clue.text: … found in note to be quite good

indicators.note: found in places the flower from the previous clue inside the note

parts.note: fah is the fourth note of the sol-fa scale
the ellipsis carries over the answer of the previous clue, the flower

explanation.surface: Something found in a musical note turns out to be pretty decent.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links back to 12-across, whose answer is the piece placed in FAH.
explanation.definitionFit: Fairish means moderately good, reasonably acceptable but not excellent.

clue.text: Companies can be left on grass in 9

indicators.note: in places the left-and-grass pair inside the story

parts.note: 9-across begins 'a tale', and a tale is a fable

indicators.note: on puts the left above the grass in this down entry

parts.note: the oat is a cereal grass

explanation.surface: Firms may be left on grassland in a story.
explanation.walkthrough: A company is floated when its shares are first offered on the stock market.
explanation.definitionFit: A company is floated by listing shares on the stock exchange, so a firm that can be is fit for flotation.

clue.text: Clearing solvers of amorous gesture

parts.note: a glade is a clearing in a wood
ye is the old plural 'you', addressing the solvers

explanation.surface: A woodland clearing where solvers make romantic overtures.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving someone the glad eye is an idiom for a flirtatious, inviting look.

clue.text: Explain how to create bliss entertaining posh police

indicators.note: entertaining means holding something as a host holds a guest

parts.note: to elate is to fill someone with joy
U stands for upper-class
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: Describe how to bring about happiness while hosting smart detectives.
explanation.definitionFit: To elucidate is to make something clear, to clarify it.

clue.text: See 9
Roman emperors were finally, but it could be reversed

indicators.note: the word reads the same in either direction, so reversing it changes nothing

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Roman emperors ended up gods, but the process might have gone the other way.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is a fill-in: Roman emperors were finally made gods. 'it could be reversed' says the answer reads the same backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: After death many Roman emperors were declared gods by the Senate, made divine.

clue.text: See 9
Beneficial payment of old money getting setback

parts.note: the anna was an old coin of India

indicators.note: back turns the word set the other way round

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A payment that does good, made in old coins after a reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beneficial' means tied to a church benefice, not helpful.
explanation.definitionFit: Annates were the first year's income of a church benefice, paid to the Pope.

clue.text: See 9
A fixer elevated into a climber

indicators.note: elevated in a down entry means read upwards

parts.note: a nail fixes things together

explanation.surface: A handyman is lifted up to join a mountaineer.
explanation.definitionFit: A liana is a woody climbing vine of tropical forests.

clue.text: See 9
Teacher raised among the great may go through the mill

indicators.note: among puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: GT is the abbreviation for great

indicators.note: raised in a down entry means written upwards

parts.note: sir is how pupils address a schoolmaster

explanation.surface: A schoolteacher promoted among the eminent may face an ordeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go through the mill' suggests suffering, but the definition is literal: grain goes through the mill.
explanation.definitionFit: Grist is grain for grinding, which literally passes through a mill.

clue.text: Long sentence in novel, I fear

indicators.note: in shows the answer sits within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A very lengthy sentence in a novel, I fear.
explanation.definitionFit: A life sentence is the longest prison term a court can hand down.

Authorisation for a relation … of the giraffe

clue.text: Get rid of Times English

parts.note: eras are periods or times

explanation.surface: Delete the Times newspaper's English section.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase is to wipe out or remove completely.

clue.text: Domestic protection for holy woman in 2

indicators.note: in places the saint and the woman inside the piece for two

parts.note: a duet is a piece for two performers
ST abbreviates saint, a holy person
she refers to a woman

explanation.surface: Household cover provided for a saintly woman inside something.
explanation.walkthrough: '2' looks like a cross-reference to 2-down, but it is the number two.
explanation.definitionFit: A dust sheet covers furniture in the home to keep off dust.
